Name: Stash Items
Author: Synvert
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png[/img]
Pressing 'R' will attempt to merge your inventory with all chests in range. This is essentially an AOE 'Add to Existing Stacks'.

This mod can be configured by editing the config.json file in the Stardew Valley/Mods/StashItems folder. This file is created when launching the game with the mod loaded.

There are currently two config options:
[list]
[*]"Radius" is the distance in tiles that will be searched for chests to stack into. (Default = 5)
[*]"StashHotKey" is the hotkey that will trigger the item stashing functionality. (Default = 'R')
[/list]
A full list of available inputs that can set as the 'StashHotKey' can be found [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/blob/develop/src/SMAPI/SButton.cs]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
﻿Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
[*]SMAPI 4.0.6 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]Single-player and Multiplayer.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/zack-hill/stardew-valley-mods]Source code[/url]﻿﻿﻿
[/list]
